image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The subject features eight distinct, overlapping calcareous plates (valves) running down the center of an elongated oval body. These plates are surrounded by a textured, leathery girdle that appears brownish-orange with small spines or granules. The background is a blurred, light-colored rock surface.
